# Continual_Learning_Neuromorphic_Hardware

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for incremental learning of new actions or tasks on neuromorphic chips without catastrophic forgetting, leveraging synaptic plasticity and online adaptation. Essential for deploying iNEST systems in dynamic environments where models must adapt continuously without retraining from scratch.
